question: Who owns the openclaw-backend production environment, and will that operator privately inspect this payment, entitlement, and deployment request?
rationale: Public service metadata assigns the failing flow to a separate hosted backend, but resolving the account-specific incident requires private production access and an accountable human operator.

options.title: Route to hosted operator
options.body: Have the openclaw-backend operator privately reconcile the transaction and deployment, redact public identifiers, and post a sanitized resolution.

options.title: Confirm ClawHub dependency
options.body: If operator investigation identifies a failing ClawHub API or identity contract, document that boundary and open a narrow repository issue with sanitized evidence.

recommendation.title: Route to hosted operator
recommendation.body: Have the openclaw-backend operator privately reconcile the transaction and deployment, redact public identifiers, and post a sanitized resolution.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main deployment and site-boundary history makes this the strongest repository-side person to identify or contact the hosted operator.
